        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base83', '|', static::class === 'Child83', '|';

$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);

purpose: Independent implicit runtime-selected inherited factory creates private static BYREF body; maker retires, SEND input and reference cache survive distinct Fiber-abort phases.
source:
<?php
class Token83R {
    function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; }
}
class Input83R {
    function __construct() {
        global $weakInput;
        $weakInput = WeakReference::create($this);
    }
    function __destruct() { echo 'INPUT|'; }
}
class Base83R {
    public function open(&$token) { return $this($token); }
    public function __invoke(&$token) { echo 'BAD-BASE|'; return []; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Mid83R extends Base83R {
    public function __invoke(&$token) {
        global $weakMaker;
        echo 'MAKE|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid83R', '|', static::class === 'Leaf83R', '|',
             $this === $weakMaker->get(), '|';
        return self::body($token);
    }
    private static function &body(&$token) {
        global $weakToken, $weakInput;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Mid83R', '|', static::class === 'Leaf83R', '|';
        try {
            $received = yield $token;
            echo 'RECEIVED|', $received === $weakInput->get(), '|';
            unset($received);
            Fiber::suspend('invoke83');
            echo 'BAD-RESUME|';
        } finally {
            echo 'FIN|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token83R, '|',
                 $weakInput->get() instanceof Input83R, '|';
        }
    }
}
class Leaf83R extends Mid83R {
    public static function body(&$token) { echo 'BAD-LEAF|'; yield 0; }
}
function Run83R() {
    global $g;
    echo 'SEND|';
    $g->send(new Input83R());
    echo 'BAD-CALLER|';
}
$maker = new Leaf83R();
$weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$token = new Token83R();
$alias =& $token;
$weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
$g = $maker->open($token);
unset($maker, $token);
$token = 83;
echo 'FRESH|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token83R, '|';
echo 'PRIME|';
$g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run83R');
$stop = new Exception('stop83');
echo 'START|';
$mark = $fiber->start();
unset($alias);
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'invoke83', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|',
     $token === 83, '|', $weakInput->get() instanceof Input83R, '|';
echo 'ABORT|';
try { $fiber->throw($stop); }
catch (Throwable $e) {
    echo 'OUT|', $e === $stop, '|', $e->getPrevious() === null, '|',
         $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $weakInput->get() === null, '|',
         $weakToken->get() instanceof Token83R, '|';
}
echo 'CLOSED|', $g->current() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token83R, '|';
unset($g, $fiber, $stop, $e);
echo 'DROP|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';
